Description: Validate a SMILES string to check if it represents a valid chemical structure.

This function checks if a given SMILES string can be converted into a valid chemical structure using RDKit. It returns True if the SMILES is valid, otherwise returns False.

- Use it when you need to validate a SMILES string before performing further chemical analysis or processing.

- The function does not perform any chemical analysis or processing; it simply checks the validity of the SMILES string.
